## 1. In short

Provider-agnostic UI contract and design toolchain: 57 components over flipova, gluestack, reusables, paper and tamagui, themed from the app's own XML registries.

Foundation is the base layer of a React Native application: a single contract of 57 components, five providers (flipova, gluestack, reusables, paper, tamagui) and the tooling that turns your application's XML design registries into theme files. You write `<Button>` once; the library that draws it is chosen in one line.

The package contains no layouts, no screens and no account logic: only the building blocks and their theme. The design belongs to your application, never to the package.

## 2. Features

| **Feature** | **What it brings** |
|--------------------|-----------------------|
| A contract of 57 components | The same properties whatever the library: changing provider requires no rewriting. |
| Five providers | flipova (all 57), gluestack, reusables, paper and tamagui, each loaded only from its own subpath. |
| Automatic fallback to flipova | A component missing from a library is served by flipova: there is never a gap. |
| Themes built from your XML registries | Colors, scales and light/dark themes are yours, validated and compiled to TypeScript. |
| Local graphical editor (`flipova-design gui`) | Edit colors, scales and themes in the browser, without leaving your machine. |
| Built-in checks | `gen --check`, `check`, `verify`, `lint` and `pipeline` detect any drift between the registries and the generated files. |

## 3. Quick installation

```bash
npm install @flipova/foundation react react-native
npx flipova-design adopt && npx flipova-design gen
```

## 4. Example

```tsx
import { FlipovaProvider, Button, Card, Heading, Text, VStack } from '@flipova/foundation';
import { paper } from '@flipova/foundation/providers/paper';
import { designTheme } from './theme/design-theme';

export default function App() {
  return (
    <FlipovaProvider adapter={paper} theme={designTheme} mode="system">
      <Card>
        <VStack space="4">
          <Heading level={2}>Bienvenue</Heading>
          <Text>Mêmes propriétés avec n'importe quel fournisseur.</Text>
          <Button onPress={() => {}}>Enregistrer</Button>
        </VStack>
      </Card>
    </FlipovaProvider>
  );
}
```

The button is drawn by react-native-paper, with the colors of your theme. Replace `paper` with another adapter: the code of your screens does not change.

## 5. Compatibility

| **Environment** | **Supported versions** |
|-------------------|-------------------------------|
| Node.js (tooling, tests) | 22 or later |
| React | 18 or later |
| React Native | 0.72 or later |
| Optional libraries | react-native-paper 5.15+, @tamagui/core 3+, @rn-primitives/switch 1+, nativewind 4.1.23+, lucide-react 0.400+ |

The flipova provider only needs `react` and `react-native`. Each other library is required only if you choose its provider.
